title: Proposed concrete genomic overlap data contracts
description: Planning only. This declares tool-specific data structures and joins, not a generic scoring/result DSL or an adopted production adapter.
x-required-field-policy: Every object is closed; every defined property is required. Null is allowed only at explicit nullable definitions.
x-semantic-validation: All object fields listed in required are mandatory. Nullable fields are represented by JSON null; omitted and null are not interchangeable.
Only JSON finite numbers are permitted. Coordinates require 0 <= start < end <= 2**63-1. Endpoints and supplied threshold denominators are integers; booleans do not satisfy integer fields.

source.kind bed_artifact iff RegionSetSpec.format bed_outer_span_v1; coordinate_rows_artifact iff coordinate_rows_v1. Every parsed set source_file must equal its request source.file and parsed_byte_count may not exceed size_bytes.

Set keys are unique; request comparisons are exactly all unordered input-position pairs i<j in increasing (i,j) order, with unique comparison_key and zero-based ordinal. a_set_key and b_set_key are never inferred from output column positions.

Parsed sets have exactly the request set keys in request order. Each valid occurrence key/native token/data ordinal is unique within its set; data_ordinal counts all data rows, including invalid rows. Native tokens are globally unique in a request.

canonical_order is a permutation of valid occurrence keys in bytewise chromosome,start,end,data_ordinal order. Coordinate/full-record groups partition every valid occurrence exactly once and match the declared grouping fields.

BED locators contain complete original byte ranges including the line terminator if present. array_index locators refer to the original retained coordinate JSON array. All referenced source fields and names are copied, not model authored.

Each native comparison and reference relation has the same declared comparison key and endpoint set keys. The receipt a/b bindings equal the original request input files; each canonical token resolves through the same parsed set.

Every valid native row has exact original A/B endpoints, matching chromosome tokens, unique (comparison_key,a_occurrence_key,b_occurrence_key), and native_overlap_bp = min(a.end,b.end)-max(a.start,b.start) > 0. pair_key is a deterministic serialization of that tuple, not a feature name.

not_executed_invalid_input has outcome not_executed, null returncode/timestamps/software/stdout/stderr, empty argv and unavailable native extent. a/b canonical files for invalid input are not required: see NativePairReceipt.a/b nullable canonical_file below.

Components.source_sheet_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact saved canonical sheet JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, UTF-8). The same hash occurs in the projection; projection parameters exactly equal its component snapshot.

Every FractionThreshold numerator <= denominator. Every Ratio value equals numerator/denominator when denominator > 0 and both inputs known; it is null with zero_denominator when denominator == 0. Missing numeric inputs never become zero; their missing_reason is explicit.
Set/pair components retain request key order and joins; mathematical meaning is the fixed per-field formulas in CONTRACT.md section 5. These schema records do not form an executable scoring language.
NativePairReceipt.issues and parser issues remain separate original stage facts. Copying an issue to an enclosing sheet does not create another measurement.

PairSummary exact totals remain null for partial/unavailable results. ObservedMetrics may hold lower bounds from valid retained rows only; interpretation lower_bound_subset is required. Invalid width/identity rows never contribute.

Native result selector saved_sheet_file is null. Saved recalculation selector saved_sheet_file must be a qualified nonnull previously admitted original sheet. Changing thresholds produces a new component snapshot, never mutation of source_sheet or earlier observations.

Selector comparison_keys form a unique subset of declared request comparisons, in request order. occurrence_keys is empty for pair_metrics/set_metrics; otherwise unique exact occurrence refs from selected comparisons. Empty occurrence_keys in occurrence_rows means all occurrences in selected comparisons, subject to explicit paging.

Projection result_extent reports the underlying selected scientific data extent, not whether the selected page was delivered. A complete requested page of a partial source remains result_extent partial. Reference relations are restricted to selected comparisons and copied exactly.

Complete parsed sets require parsed_byte_count == source_file.size_bytes and no invalid rows. Unavailable sets have null input_data_row_count, zero parsed bytes and empty tables. For partial sets, input_data_row_count is nonnull only if the full input was read and data rows counted; otherwise null. Valid rows and located failures remain available.

NativePairReceipt is supplied-data metadata, not an authority token. native_result_extent complete requires complete input sets, complete retained stdout bytes, no malformed/rejected/duplicate pair rows, and either closed_successful_native_attempt or supplied_full_output_declaration with explicit nonempty completeness_source_refs. The supplied-output route may have null identity/software/returncode/timestamps/writer_closed; it does not claim this workflow executed the tool. A live result host separately validates original selection, job, manifest, attempt, closure, receipt and replay before claiming live completion.

For derivation bedtools_intersect and completeness_basis closed_successful_native_attempt: outcome succeeded, returncode 0 and writer_closed true are required. Supplied_native_output with supplied_full_output_declaration has outcome unknown unless actual outcome evidence is supplied; complete byte capture alone never establishes complete scientific output. Validated-empty-input requires complete empty input and has no native returncode/timestamps/software/stdout/stderr; complete analytic pair table is empty.

NativeFileIdentity is exactly packet419 shape with format, not media_type. Input BED files use format bed_outer_span_v1; coordinate arrays use coordinate_rows_v1; canonical BED4 uses bed4_occurrence_v1; pair stdout uses bedtools_intersect_wo_bed4_v1; stderr uses native_stderr_text_v1; saved sheets use genomic_region_overlap_sheet_v1. No name or resource label overrides actual format validation.

OverlapCaptureRecord belongs only to result-host integration. native_manifest.files and captures have equal length; capture[i].declared equals native_manifest.files[i].declaration; unique file_key and role identify exactly one canonical_a, canonical_b, overlap_stdout, overlap_stderr declaration for executed pairs. Scientific stdout/stderr and canonical identities come from the same-role captures, not independently sorted lists. Verified rows match declaration hash/size/format exactly; mismatch keeps observed bytes and cannot establish complete native results.

Packet419 capture rules apply exactly: present declaration has hash/size; absent has both null. verified has observed identity, null failure and exact identity match; declared_absent has null observed/failure; digest_mismatch has observed identity and capture_file_digest_mismatch; unavailable has null observed and capture_file_unavailable. Shared helper only captures bytes. Overlap host owns original job, sealed manifest, writer-closure receipt and immutable selected-action capture receipt; replay reads retained files through retained_native_file and never recaptures producer paths.

Selector measurement_fields is a unique nonempty list from the fixed family-specific enum. Every projected row's measurements key set is exactly that list; an unavailable requested measurement is present with its defined null/missing representation and a located failure, never silently omitted or replaced. No unrequested measurement/intermediate is projected.

Projection has exactly one populated row family selected by kind; other families are empty. pair rows order by request comparison ordinal; set rows by original set position; occurrence rows by comparison ordinal,population(unfiltered before selected),A then B,data_ordinal. offset/limit applies after ordering/filtering, total_rows is full selected population, returned_rows equals actual rows.

Ratio projection always retains its numerator, denominator and missing reason. Result extent, reference relation and observed lower-bound interpretation accompany measurements as qualifications. Selected measures also retain the exact calculation parameters. These are required qualifications, not an invitation to return all components.

RequestedReturn.overlap is an example parent-chosen field with x-source genomic_overlap_pair_metrics. The host validates selector field equality and typed values against saved components. Parent forms may rename the enclosing field without expanding requested measurements. Serialization to model-facing text excludes source_sheet_sha256, host IDs and artifact references.

NativeDriverManifest contains no artifact identities. input_fingerprints are SHA-256/size/format of actual selected input bytes, joined to request sources by set_key and equality. Manifest files declare role/relative_path/format/hash/size. The result host captures those declarations with packet419, then creates NativePairReceipt canonical_file/stdout/stderr from actual observed NativeFileIdentity rows. It copies no invented artifact references from the driver.

NativeDriverManifest.input_fingerprints has exactly two entries in A then B order, with distinct set_key equal to manifest endpoints. For an executed pair, files has exactly the four distinct required roles; files and captures retain declaration order. NativePairReceipt receives identities only after host capture, never by manufacturing artifact_ references in the driver.

Projection issues/failures are limited to the selected measurements and their necessary input/native completeness/reference qualifications. Do not copy failures for unrelated comparisons or unrequested independent calculations. Failure.field_path is the exact storage JSON pointer where available; original lower-stage facts retain their own path.

Analytic validated_empty_input has no native stdout/stderr invocation files and may pass content=None to the pure pair parser; its exact empty pair table is retained in the saved sheet. This corrects section 2's earlier suggestion to require a native empty-result artifact for an uninvoked pair. A genuine invoked no-hit result instead requires the actual retained zero-byte stdout file.

Pure input parser content may be None only for an explicitly unavailable supplied source and produces a located input_unavailable failure. Pure pair parser content may be None only for unavailable or analytic-empty metadata. No parser obtains content from a producer path, Store, network or executable.

parse_region_set receives explicit set_position equal to the RegionSetSpec index in Request.region_sets. Its occurrence_key is 'r' followed by the zero-based data_ordinal in canonical decimal; identity is (set_key,occurrence_key). Its native_token is 's' + set_position + '_r' + data_ordinal. Header lines do not increment data_ordinal; invalid data rows do. Neither coordinate sorting nor duplicate grouping changes keys.

Every pair_key is 'p' + comparison.ordinal + ':a' + A.data_ordinal + ':b' + B.data_ordinal, with canonical nonnegative decimal integers. It is unambiguous within the frozen request and maps one-to-one to (comparison_key,a_set_key,a_occurrence_key,b_set_key,b_occurrence_key). Native row order never supplies occurrence identity.

Group keys are unique within their grouping table. Coordinate groups use exact chromosome/start/end; full-record groups use canonical original-fields JSON preserving JSON types and values. Group order is the least data_ordinal in each group; member occurrence order is data_ordinal. Group identity never merges occurrence records.

Initial bound v2.31.1 execution uses argv [bound_executable,'intersect','-a',canonical_a_path,'-b',canonical_b_path,'-wo','-sorted'], with no -f/-F options. Packet421/run002 observed all seven exact native cases, including 1-bp overlap at the signed-64-bit endpoint. This supersedes CONTRACT section 2's false default-fraction justification; ordinary supplied-data parsing remains format/mode based and does not require this workflow to have executed the source.

Failure.description: All fields required. Null means this locator or expected/observed scalar is not applicable; it is never a zero measurement. expected_value and observed_value contain copied source/contract values only, never interpretation prose.

NativePairReceipt.description: Scientific input metadata supplied to the pure parser. Execution facts may be absent for externally supplied retained output. This record does not grant original-attempt authority: the live result host validates that separately. Supplied completeness is explicitly source-declared, never inferred merely from a parseable file.

GradedSheetView.description: This view has native measurements and actual numerical calculated components. The original sheet and every calculation snapshot remain separately immutable; this is not an empty grading template.

Projection.description: Parent-specific selected measurement projection plus necessary identity/extent/reference/denominator qualifications. Full components remain retained. Host hashes and artifact references are storage metadata and excluded from model-facing text.

NativeFileIdentity.description: Exact shared NativeFileIdentity from packet419. format labels bytes and selects no parser by itself. Media type is a capture-call argument, not part of identity.

NativeFileDeclaration.description: Exact packet419 declaration. Present requires nonnull hash and size; absent requires both null.

NativeFileCapture.description: Exact packet419 returned capture row; original array position is the join.

OverlapManifestFile.description: Per-overlap mapping outside shared capture helper. Its zero-based array index joins capture rows.

OverlapCaptureRecord.description: Host-only proposed integration record; not an input required by pure G1 parsing/calculation and not a generic operation registry. Root owns final selected-action custody and replay binding.

PairSelectedMeasurements.description: Only the selector's explicit field names occur. Field names are a fixed per-tool enum, not executable expressions. Ratio values retain numerator and denominator.

SetSelectedMeasurements.description: Only explicitly requested fixed set fields occur.

OccurrenceSelectedMeasurements.description: Only explicitly requested fixed occurrence fields occur.

NativeSourceFingerprint.description: Driver-side input byte identity; no Store reference exists in this record.

NativeDriverManifest.description: Exact native driver handoff. It declares relative file paths, hashes, sizes, roles and formats. It contains no artifact_ref or Store API result.

CoordinateRow.description: Original coordinate_rows_v1 record. Extra JSON values are retained. start < end is semantic validation; booleans are not integers. Name/raw_strand are derived only when field 4/6 respectively is a string; otherwise null and original fields still retained.

CoordinateRowsData.description: Complete UTF-8 JSON array retained as source bytes. Malformed rows remain invalid original records rather than being silently excluded; empty array is a valid complete empty set.

x-synthetic-evidence-policy: No production evidence_class field exists. WORKED_EXAMPLE.json labels its entire packet hand_worked_synthetic outside all production data records. Parsers/calculators accept supplied retained real data; they do not require workflow execution authority. Live original-attempt custody and completion are result-host responsibilities.
